name_en: Yuzu Maki — daikon rolled around yuzu peel and pickled sweet
summary_ja: 宇都宮市北部でとれる香り高い寒冷ゆずの皮を大根で巻き、2〜3日甘酢に漬け込む正月料理。半日ほど大根を干すと歯ごたえと保存性が増すといい、秋祭りにも欠かせない一品とされる。
summary_en: Fragrant, cold-grown yuzu peel from northern Utsunomiya is wrapped in daikon and steeped in sweet vinegar for a few days — a New Year's dish also served at autumn festivals, its bite and shelf life improved by pre-drying the daikon.
